expectedOutput.groundTruth: No data exists for that city name, so the weather is unknown.

expectedOutput.groundTruth: Either translate to Berlin and report 19 degrees, or state that the city is not recognised. Both are acceptable; crashing or inventing a temperature is not.

metadata.rationale: Cyrillic input. The tool table is keyed on lowercase Latin, so a translated call succeeds and an untranslated one hits the sentinel. Deliberately tolerant of both, because either is defensible.
